san_francisco.name: San Francisco
san_francisco.theme: Venture capitalism, tech hustle, high pressure, existential ambition.

sequence_rules.default: Focus on late-night pitch deck revisions, startup competition, and high living costs.

saigon.name: Saigon
saigon.theme: Roots, family expectations, nostalgia, street food, returning home.

sequence_rules.from_san_francisco: Family expresses relief at your return, but immediately asks why you haven't bought a home or gotten married yet.
sequence_rules.from_berlin: Your wild, bohemian lifestyle choices clash heavily with your family's conservative traditional expectations.
sequence_rules.from_london: Your distant, formal demeanor breaks down under the warmth of street food vendors and childhood memories.

taipei.name: Taipei
taipei.theme: Mindfulness, night market culture, quiet healing, craft coffee, misty mountains.

sequence_rules.from_san_francisco: The sudden drop in pacing feels strange; night market conversations force you to slow down and reflect.
sequence_rules.from_seoul: Transitioning from hyper-competitive status loops into Taipei's gentler pace offers deep emotional recovery.

seoul.name: Seoul
seoul.theme: Hyper-modern aesthetics, relentless perfectionism, neon nights, high fashion.

sequence_rules.from_saigon: The urge to prove your success abroad drives you to overwork and adopt an immaculate outer persona.
sequence_rules.from_tokyo: Moving between two hyper-dense metropolises highlights contrast between Japanese quiet order and Korean raw energy.

buenos_aires.name: Buenos Aires
buenos_aires.theme: Passion, artistic melancholy, romance, literary cafes, tango, inflation anxiety.

sequence_rules.from_san_francisco: Abandoning tech sanity for South American art creates immediate financial worry paired with sudden emotional liberation.
sequence_rules.from_london: Stripping away high-society posturing reveals raw, unfiltered human connection.

hyderabad.name: Hyderabad
hyderabad.theme: Tech innovation meets royal heritage, spice markets, extended family warmth.

sequence_rules.from_san_francisco: You recognize familiar tech jargon, but here it is deeply intertwined with family obligations and local heritage.
sequence_rules.from_saigon: The shared Asian focus on family hospitality makes this vibrant city feel like a home away from home.

berlin.name: Berlin
berlin.theme: Underground counterculture, techno subcultures, anti-establishment, gritty freedom.

sequence_rules.from_san_francisco: Complete cultural rejection of Silicon Valley capitalism; corporate speak gets you shut out of creative circles.
sequence_rules.from_seoul: Shaking off intense perfectionism leads to wild, unfiltered self-expression in dark venues.

tokyo.name: Tokyo
tokyo.theme: Neon isolation, urban serenity, craftsmanship, quiet observational discipline.

sequence_rules.from_buenos_aires: Moving from passionate chaos into hyper-structured silence creates intense culture shock.
sequence_rules.from_san_francisco: Workaholic habits translate into deep respect for Japanese craft and attention to detail.

london.name: London
london.theme: Legacy wealth, global power, rain-slicked streets, institutional prestige.

sequence_rules.from_saigon: Achieving elite status in a global capital exposes the distance between your current life and your humble roots.
sequence_rules.from_berlin: Putting on a suit and returning to structured corporate life feels like wearing a mask.
